dct_description_sm: This dataset includes temperature, pH and means ± standard deviations (n = 3) of dissolved ions at sampling sites, calculated free metal ion concentrations and measured metal biofilm content in streams of Nunavik in 2014 and 2015.
dct_title_s: Data for the paper entitled "Proton competition and free ion activities drive cadmium, copper and nickel accumulation in river biofilms in a Nordic ecosystem"
